_comment: Per-module result of the feature E2E suite in CI run 41437234529 (workflow CI, job "Real-stack browser journeys (zero mocks)", main commit bb1f6586, 2 Nov 2026). Parsed from the job log by counting the "-> applicable N, passed N, failed N, blocked N" line under each "=== module" header. Blocked reasons are read from web/apps/web/test/features/modules/*.mjs at 9c651837. A pass means the web behaved as the frozen case expects; it is not a comparison with the Windows desktop.

company-master.reason: Blocked by the known open G38/G39 Company prerequisite or its unavailable downstream stage: ${reason}

sales-invoice.reason: Expected behaviour undecided: no desktop source refuses a negative weight, and the web saves it. Needs an original-Windows run to decide refuse vs accept.
